thread:
Marta Novak: FYI we just got an escalation from ACME — their indexing pipeline started rejecting batches after last night's model swap. They see a 422 with 'vector_dim_mismatch'.
Samir Patel: ugh. which model was deployed? any quick sample logs?
Marta Novak: deployed embed-v3 (pushed 02:10 UTC). It produces 2048-d embeddings. Indexer still configured for 1536. heartrate started ~02:30 when most traffic hits. sample error from indexer:
```
ERROR InsertFailed: id=acme:12345 code=422 reason="expected_dim=1536 got_dim=2048" batch_id=2489
trace: /srv/indexer/ingest/worker.go:412
```
Samir Patel: can you paste the outgoing embedding payload from the gateway? need to confirm where the mismatch originates.
Marta Novak: posted minimal request we saw hitting the gateway (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model": "embed-v3", "inputs": ["How to reset password"] }
response: 200 OK
embeddings[0].length = 2048
```
Kai Robinson: concordant. embed-v3 is 2048. Indexer config shows `expected_embedding_dim: 1536` in prod. Two paths: (A) revert model to embed-v2 (1536) for ACME customer, or (B) make indexer accept 2048 and schedule backfill to reindex older vectors.
Elaine Chen: customer on an enterprise Dedicated plan — they flagged billing noise because half their batches failed then retried by client, doubling token/batch counts. We should notify billing and patch support ticket #SUP-3421. Also need to confirm dedupe behavior on reingest.
indexer-bot: ALERT: 200 failed index insert events in last 10m for customer acme-corp (cluster idx-prod-7). Top reason: expected_dim_mismatch. Related logs: https://logs.internal/idx-prod-7/2003456789
oncall: tagging @kai and @samir — need a mitigation now, please propose a short rollback or config flip.
Samir Patel: mitigation plan PR:
1) Temporarily enable a permissive mode on indexer to accept 2048 while we stage backfill: `indexerctl set accept_variable_dims=true --cluster idx-prod-7` (low-risk, only for acme namespace)
2) Start a canary reingest for a 1h window to validate dedupe and query correctness
3) If canary OK, schedule controlled backfill for 48h with throttling (rate=200r/s)
I can push the config toggle. It requires a restart of the index consumer (rolling 1 node at a time).
Kai Robinson: note: accept_variable_dims will increase memory per shard; we must watch GC and max_ram_per_pod. I'll coordinate autoscaling and bump pod requests by 20% during the rollover.
Marta Novak: customer context: they have ~120M vectors (mostly 1536) and incremental writes since 02:00 are ~120k (these failed). They want minimal downtime. I'll tell them short window for config flip and reingest schedule.
Elaine Chen: for billing I'll flag a one-time credit for the duplicate writes post-failure. Assign to billing@ to review after we confirm retry counts.
Samir Patel: repro steps for eng to validate locally:
```
# fetch sample document from acme staging
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://gateway.internal/acme/doc/12345 | jq .text > sample.txt
# call embeddings
python -c "from client import Api; print(len(Api.embeddings('embed-v3', open('sample.txt').read())))"  # expects 2048
# run indexer local insert (emulate shard check)
./indexer --expected-dim=1536 --insert --file=payload.json  # should fail with mismatch
```
Kai Robinson: thanks. I'll run a perf pass after Samir flips the flag. We'll watch the indexer GC/pod restarts; if any OOMs happen we revert and do scheduled downtime.
indexer-bot: NOTE: maintenance window scheduled: rolling restart idx-prod-7 nodes starting in 15m for config change. ETA 20m
oncall: I'll update the incident ticket INC-9876 and ping the customer slack channel with the mitigation and ETA. Marta, pls confirm the customer opt-in for the short restart.
Marta Novak: ACME ops confirmed 'do it asap, keep us posted'. I'll post intermediate updates to SUP-3421 and customer channel.
Elaine Chen: action items: 
- Samir: flip accept_variable_dims for acme (IDX-PR-451)
- Kai: monitor resource utilization + prepare rollback (IDX-PR-452)
- Marta: coordinate customer comms + reingest window
- Billing: prepare credit recommendation
Samir Patel: flipping now. will post when the toggle completes. :thumbsup:
Marta Novak: thx. if anyone sees unexpected query regressions after reingest canary, capture examples and route to eng-ml for quality checks. we should also add an alert for embedding-dim drift on future model swaps to avoid this.
Kai Robinson: +1 to dim-drift alert. I'll add rule: if deployed model dim != indexer expected_dim -> slack notify + block automated deploy for 'critical' customers.
Samir Patel: toggle done. 1 node restarted, canary ingest started (batch id range 2490-2505). first results look clean.
Marta Novak: customer notified. closing loop once backfill validated.
Elaine Chen: updating ticket and billing. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
